kubectl create deployment tiles-v2 -n geo-114f --image=busybox:1.36 --replicas=2 --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
cat tiles.yaml | grep -v "^  name: tiles$" | cat - <(echo "  name: tiles-v2") | kubectl apply -n geo-114f -f -

python3 -I << 'EOF'
import sys
import yaml

with open('tiles.yaml', 'r') as f:
    doc = yaml.safe_load(f)

doc['metadata']['name'] = 'tiles-v2'

print(yaml.dump(doc))
EOF
cat tiles.yaml | jq '.metadata.name = "tiles-v2"' | kubectl apply -n geo-114f -f -

cat << 'EOF' | kubectl apply -n geo-114f -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: tiles-v2
  labels:
    app: tiles
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: tiles
      scheme: v2
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: tiles
        scheme: v2
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 2
      containers:
      - name: tiles
        image: busybox:1.36
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - sleep 6; touch /tmp/ready; exec httpd -f -p 8080
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 16Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 64Mi
        readinessProbe:
          exec:
            command:
            - test
            - -f
            - /tmp/ready
          periodSeconds: 1
          failureThreshold: 1
EOF
